The '''1938–39 Scottish Division One''' was the last season of competitive football in Scotland before [[World War II]]. The league championship was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by eleven points over nearest rival [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dailyrecord.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/rangers-supporters-campaign-world-war-10952292|title=Rangers supporters campaign for World War Two titles to be recognised by SFA and SPFL|date=8 August 2017|website=Daily Record|access-date=4 January 2022}}</ref>
